batch: Phase E1 -- final sweep, batch 1 (M01-M10), 11 confirmed misclassifications found and verse-checked
scope_note: This begins the researcher-requested final sweep: every one of ~94 cluster groups (M-codes + T-codes) reviewed for member fit, working toward full coverage of every strong. Batch 1 covers M01 (Fear & Awe) through M10 (Violence & Cruelty), 862 members total. Anomalies found by reading every member's gloss against the cluster's own theme, then verse-checked (not gloss-only) before any change -- same discipline as every prior correction this session.

relocations.note: 'necessary/one must' (Matt.18.7, Rom.13.5) -- confirmed via verse-check, means obligation, not fear. escalation #1598 Phase E1

'of what kind?' -- confirmed via verse-check (Matt.8.27 'what sort of man', Mark.13.1 'what wonderful stones') -- an interrogative, homonym trap on 'kind', nothing to do with kindness. escalation #1598 Phase E1
'family: kind' -- confirmed via verse-check (1Cor.12.10/12.28 'various kinds' of gifts) -- means 'type/category', same homonym trap as G4217. escalation #1598 Phase E1
'be away' -- confirmed via verse-check (2Cor.5.6/5.8 'away from the body/Lord') -- a spatial-relational term, nothing to do with shame. escalation #1598 Phase E1
'to delay' -- confirmed via verse-check (1Tim.3.15, 2Pet.3.9 'slow') -- temporal, nothing to do with humility. escalation #1598 Phase E1
'to delay' -- confirmed via verse-check (Dan.9.19, Gen.32.4 'stayed') -- temporal, nothing to do with humility. escalation #1598 Phase E1
'to direct' -- confirmed via verse-check (Matt.27.10/26.19 'directed/appointed') -- means 'to appoint', nothing to do with humility. escalation #1598 Phase E1
'dignity' -- confirmed via verse-check (1Tim.2.2/3.4 'dignified/dignity') -- genuinely closer to gravitas/respectability than to lowliness; arguably the opposite sense. escalation #1598 Phase E1

'to stink' -- confirmed via verse-check (John.11.39, Lazarus' body, literal decay-odor) -- not a 'being detestable' metaphor as first hypothesized; a purely literal physical sense. escalation #1598 Phase E1

removals.note: 'even/who' -- a particle, already correctly tagged T2 separately; the M08 tag was wrong (Heb.3.6-style emphatic particle, nothing to do with pride)
'indeed' -- a conditional/emphatic particle (Heb.3.6/3.14 'if indeed'), already correctly tagged T2 separately; the M08 tag was wrong

flagged_uncertain_not_changed.note: verse-checked (2Sam.22.5/Ps.88.7 'waves of death encompassed me') -- plausible terror-metaphor, left as-is rather than forced either way
verse-checked -- 'Alas' (2Sam.14.5) is a genuine lament-interjection, plausibly correct; 'No' (1Kgs.1.43) is a plain negation. Mixed sense, left as-is
verse-checked (Isa.30.7/Ps.87.4) -- the poetic epithet for Egypt/chaos-monster, plausibly a pride/defiance symbol in context. Left as-is, genuinely ambiguous

these were deferred from T12 (Objects) earlier as ambiguous; found here already tagged M03 (Grief) -- the Hebrew root for 'cord' also covers 'pang/anguish' (cf. Ps.18.5-6 'cords of death/Sheol'), a genuine, plausible dual-sense. Confirms the earlier deferral was correct; no action needed
